title: Draw your first cube
summary: A mesh joins a shape with a material. The scene holds the mesh, and the renderer draws it from the camera's view.
introduction: A mesh joins a shape with a material. The scene holds the mesh, and the renderer draws it from the camera's view. Your task: Change the cube colour in MeshBasicMaterial.

Explain the example for draw your first cube

blocks.text: A mesh joins a shape with a material. The scene holds the mesh, and the renderer draws it from the camera's view.

Use a browser project with the three package installed and a module build tool. Each example creates its own canvas. Run one at a time. These library imports are not supported by this site's plain runner.

blocks.title: Draw your first cube

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: Three.js rotation values use radians. `Math.PI / 2` is a quarter turn.
A perspective camera needs a field of view, aspect ratio, near distance and far distance to describe its view.
`MeshBasicMaterial` gives a visible surface without requiring lights. It is useful for a first shape example.

blocks.text: A blue cube appears on the new canvas, turned slightly so its shape is visible.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Adding an object to a scene does not draw it by itself. Call render with a scene and camera.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the cube colour in MeshBasicMaterial.
